feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: Microsoft offers 'buyouts' to 60,000 staff including UK workers
articles.summary: Microsoft is offering voluntary severance packages to 60,000 of its staff - more than a quarter of its workforce - including some in the UK.

articles.title: Harry Kane ends England's 25-year wait to win men's Ballon d'Or
articles.summary: Harry Kane has won the 2026 Ballon d'Or, becoming the first Englishman to win football's most prestigious individual trophy in 25 years.

articles.title: Man who died after being hit by falling tree in Storm Boelo is named
articles.summary: Tributes have been paid to a man who died after being struck by a falling tree during Storm Boelo.

articles.title: Drivers who killed mother and young daughter as they raced are jailed
articles.summary: Two strangers who killed a mother and her four-year-old daughter as they raced their high-performance cars along a city centre road have been jailed for 16 and 12 years.

articles.title: UK sanctions senior Sudanese commanders 'implicated in rape campaign'
articles.summary: Senior Sudanese commanders allegedly implicated in a campaign of rape during the country's conflict have been sanctioned by the UK government.

articles.title: London's Oxford Street pedestrianised in 'truly momentous occasion for capital'
articles.summary: London's Oxford Street is now traffic-free, with mayor Sadiq Khan hailing it "a truly momentous occasion for the capital".

articles.title: Senior doctors to strike for two days in November
articles.summary: Senior doctors in England plan to go on strike for two days in November over pay, the British Medical Association (BMA) has said.

articles.title: Met Office issues new weather warning for wind - as two men killed by falling trees
articles.summary: The Met Office has issued a new wind weather warning after Storm Boelo pummelled the UK with gusts of up to 84mph, flooded streets and caused power cuts to 800,000 homes.
